en-IN.name: Octopus
en-IN.summary: Talk to The Den and Octopus, your AI workers.
en-IN.description: Ask what's in the queue, what Octopus is working on and what needs your approval; approve or deny by voice; add tasks, push code and talk a task through before it's queued.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my octopus what's in the queue
Alexa, ask my octopus what approvals are waiting
